description: Indexes a view that already exists, which also has to bind it to its schema first. A corpus only ever creates from empty, so this is the only place the order of the two is tested.

postgres.because: Postgres has no schema-binding clause to write and stores no rows for a plain view to index; only a materialized view can carry indexes.

sqlite.because: SQLite has neither schema binding nor indexes on views: a view is re-parsed at each use and stores nothing to index.
